material_outcomes: The 12 workers produced 72 preserved raw leads and 69 canonical subjects after three exact merges.
Blank-slate workers contributed 16 subjects not found by memory-assisted workers.
Nine Local leads were actually dated Events subjects or mixed place-plus-occurrence records.
Seven of twelve worker outputs required one bounded schema correction.
Nine subjects received 43 evidence claims and independent Trust review: five approve, two revise and two hold.
One pre-recommendation PERSONAL_FIT policy violation passed both JSON Schema and Trust and was blocked only by final integration audit.

failures.description: Nine Local leads were finite events or mixed place-and-occurrence records, exposing an ownership rule that is not mechanically testable.
failures.corrective_action: Split persistent venue identity from dated occurrence at normalization and add an ownership invariant before department handoff.

failures.description: Seven worker outputs initially violated the declared enum or raw-lead envelope and required one bounded schema correction before union.
failures.corrective_action: Validate worker output at the dispatcher boundary and return exact field-level errors for the single retry.

failures.description: Galaxy Robot Park had official opening and self-reported demand evidence but lacked an official street address, hours, admission price and current booking method.
failures.corrective_action: Require a minimum execution-fact set before a permanent place can pass Trust for product exposure.

failures.description: The 7979 running session showed a future calendar but booking was not yet open and the same official surface also displayed a service-ended label.
failures.corrective_action: Model not-yet-open separately from unavailable and recheck after the published opening timestamp.

failures.description: STORY A's active booking path was found, but the KRW 30,000 reference-price basis, opening-special duration and coupon conditions were not established.
failures.corrective_action: Suppress reference-price savings and urgency until historical price and expiry are independently established.

failures.description: A Global evidence assembler assigned PERSONAL_FIT without a user decision context, and the Trust reviewer approved the global signal without rejecting that chip support.
failures.corrective_action: Make PERSONAL_FIT structurally impossible outside a recommendation context and add a post-Trust invariant validator.

successes.repeatable_method: Search official museum and cultural institution openings without restaurant or merchant watchlists.
Join opening news with live merchant branch pages and dated promotion terms.

successes.discovery_path: local edge discovery followed by Events handoff and replacement booking resolution
successes.repeatable_method: Preserve closed booking URLs as provenance and follow same-business replacement products before declaring closure.
Merge duplicate company signals while separating launch attention, self-reported adoption and economic durability.
